var_path.description: Base directory where opencryptoki stores runtime files such as sockets and logs.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to assist troubleshooting.

max_threads.description: Maximum number of worker threads to handle concurrent PKCS#11 operations.

modules.description: List of PKCS#11 token modules (e.g., software, hardware) to load and manage.

name.description: Unique identifier for the module (used as section name in config).

path.description: Absolute path to the module’s shared library (.so file).

description.description: Human-readable description shown in PKCS#11 tools.

enabled.description: Whether this module should be loaded at startup.

parameters.description: Key-value pairs of module-specific parameters (e.g., device path, timeout).

slot_defaults.slot_id.description: Default slot ID used when tokens are inserted without explicit slot mapping.

slot_defaults.user_pin.description: Default user PIN (SO PIN) for token initialization. WARNING: Hardcoding PINs is insecure. Leave blank for manual PIN entry.

slot_defaults.manual_token_init.description: If true, tokens require manual initialization via pkcsconf or similar tools.
